info.title: Hypercerts API
info.description: Public Hypercerts XRPC endpoints. Coverage labels describe local source manifests, not deployment or runtime verification.

get.description: Gets an actor's indexed organization sidecar and associated profile by DID. Authentication is not required.

parameters.name: actor
parameters.description: DID of the actor to look up.

x-lexicon-errors.name: InvalidRequest
x-lexicon-errors.description: The actor DID is invalid or an unsupported parameter was supplied.

x-lexicon-errors.name: RecordNotFound
x-lexicon-errors.description: No indexed organization sidecar exists for this DID.

x-lexicon-errors.name: OrganizationQueryFailed
x-lexicon-errors.description: The indexed organization sidecar or associated profile could not be queried.

get.description: Returns an indexed organization sidecar and associated profile for each supplied actor DID. Authentication is not required.

parameters.name: actors
parameters.description: Actor DIDs to look up, supplied as repeated unbracketed query values.

x-lexicon-errors.name: InvalidRequest
x-lexicon-errors.description: An actor DID or query parameter is invalid.

x-lexicon-errors.name: OrganizationQueryFailed
x-lexicon-errors.description: The indexed organization sidecars or associated profiles could not be queried.

get.description: Gets an indexed Certified profile by DID or handle. Handles resolve through the configured resolver's com.atproto.identity.resolveHandle endpoint; no DID document is fetched for independent verification. Authentication is not required.

parameters.name: actor
parameters.description: DID or handle of the profile actor.

x-lexicon-errors.name: InvalidRequest
x-lexicon-errors.description: The actor is not a valid DID or handle, or an unsupported parameter was supplied.

x-lexicon-errors.name: HandleResolverConfigError
x-lexicon-errors.description: HYPERCERTS_HANDLE_RESOLVER_URL is missing or invalid.

x-lexicon-errors.name: HandleResolutionFailed
x-lexicon-errors.description: The handle could not be resolved to a valid DID.

x-lexicon-errors.name: RecordNotFound
x-lexicon-errors.description: The actor was identified, but no indexed Certified profile exists.

x-lexicon-errors.name: ProfileQueryFailed
x-lexicon-errors.description: The indexed profile could not be queried.

get.description: Returns an indexed Certified profile for each supplied actor DID. Authentication is not required.

parameters.name: actors
parameters.description: Actor DIDs to look up, supplied as repeated unbracketed query values.

x-lexicon-errors.name: InvalidRequest
x-lexicon-errors.description: An actor DID or query parameter is invalid.

x-lexicon-errors.name: ProfileQueryFailed
x-lexicon-errors.description: The indexed profiles could not be queried.

get.description: Lists actors with indexed organization sidecars matching the supplied filters. Filters combine with AND, and values within each array filter are ORed. Authentication is not required.

parameters.name: organizationTypes
parameters.description: Exact organizationType values; OR within this filter.

parameters.name: visibility
parameters.description: Exact visibility match; omission is unrestricted, but records with no visibility value do not match.

parameters.name: sortDirection
parameters.description: Sort by a valid zoned createdAt, otherwise indexedAt, falling back to row creation time; URI breaks ties. Default desc.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size; default 25.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor bound to sortDirection; keep other parameters unchanged between pages.

x-lexicon-errors.name: InvalidRequest
x-lexicon-errors.description: A filter or scalar parameter is invalid or repeated, or an unsupported parameter was supplied.

x-lexicon-errors.name: OrganizationQueryFailed
x-lexicon-errors.description: The indexed organization sidecar or associated profile could not be queried.

get.description: Lists indexed Certified profiles with pagination. Authentication is not required.

parameters.name: sortDirection
parameters.description: Sort by a valid zoned createdAt, otherwise indexedAt, falling back to row creation time; URI breaks ties. Default desc.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size; default 25.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor bound to sortDirection; keep parameters unchanged between pages. Pages are not a snapshot.

x-lexicon-errors.name: InvalidRequest
x-lexicon-errors.description: A pagination parameter is invalid, repeated where scalar, or unsupported.

x-lexicon-errors.name: ProfileQueryFailed
x-lexicon-errors.description: The indexed profiles could not be queried.

get.description: Searches organizations by associated profile text and optional filters. Filters combine with AND, and values within each array filter are ORed. Authentication is not required.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Trimmed text is matched literally and case-insensitively as a substring in either displayName or description. Blank text is unrestricted; nonblank text requires an associated profile.

parameters.name: actors
parameters.description: Actor DIDs to include; values are ORed and handles are not resolved.

parameters.name: organizationTypes
parameters.description: Exact organizationType values; OR within this filter.

parameters.name: visibility
parameters.description: Exact visibility match; omission is unrestricted, but records with no visibility value do not match.

parameters.name: sortDirection
parameters.description: Sort by a valid zoned createdAt, otherwise indexedAt, falling back to row creation time; URI breaks ties. Default desc.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size; default 25.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor bound to sortDirection; keep other parameters unchanged between pages.

x-lexicon-errors.name: InvalidRequest
x-lexicon-errors.description: A filter or scalar parameter is invalid or repeated, or an unsupported parameter was supplied.

x-lexicon-errors.name: OrganizationQueryFailed
x-lexicon-errors.description: The indexed organization sidecar or associated profile could not be queried.

get.description: Searches indexed Certified profiles by text, optionally restricted to actor DIDs. Filters combine with AND; values in the actor array are ORed. Authentication is not required.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Trimmed text is matched literally and case-insensitively as a substring in displayName or description. Blank text is unrestricted.

parameters.name: sortDirection
parameters.description: Sort by a valid zoned createdAt, otherwise indexedAt, falling back to row creation time; URI breaks ties. Default desc.

parameters.name: actors
parameters.description: Actor DIDs to include; values are ORed and handles are not resolved.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size; default 25.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor bound to sortDirection; keep parameters unchanged between pages. Pages are not a snapshot.

x-lexicon-errors.name: InvalidRequest
x-lexicon-errors.description: A filter or pagination parameter is invalid, repeated where scalar, or unsupported.

x-lexicon-errors.name: ProfileQueryFailed
x-lexicon-errors.description: The indexed profiles could not be queried.

get.description: Gets a badge award and its recipient response by AT-URI without authentication.

parameters.name: uri
parameters.description: Full AT-URI of the badge-award record.

x-lexicon-errors.name: BadgeAwardQueryFailed

get.description: Returns an indexed badge definition and its publisher actor. Authentication is not required.

parameters.name: uri
parameters.description: AT-URI of a badge definition with a DID authority; lookup matches the URI, not a record CID.

x-lexicon-errors.name: InvalidRequest

x-lexicon-errors.name: RecordNotFound

get.description: Gets one badge response by AT-URI without authentication.

parameters.name: uri
parameters.description: Full AT-URI of the badge-response record.

x-lexicon-errors.name: InvalidRequest

x-lexicon-errors.name: RecordNotFound

get.description: Lists public badge awards with recipient response status and pagination without authentication.

parameters.name: authors
parameters.description: DIDs of repositories that published the awards.

parameters.name: badgeUris
parameters.description: Badge-definition AT-URIs.

parameters.name: badgeTypes

parameters.name: subjects
parameters.description: DIDs or full record AT-URIs with valid collection NSIDs.

parameters.name: responses
parameters.description: Computed recipient response statuses.

parameters.name: sortDirection
parameters.description: Sort direction for (createdAt, uri).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum awards returned.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page.

x-lexicon-errors.name: InvalidRequest
x-lexicon-errors.description: A filter or page parameter is invalid.

x-lexicon-errors.name: BadgeAwardQueryFailed
x-lexicon-errors.description: The indexed badge awards could not be queried.

get.description: Lists indexed badge definitions. Author and badgeType filters are combined with AND; values within each filter are matched with OR. Authentication is not required.

parameters.name: authors
parameters.description: Publisher DIDs to include.

parameters.name: badgeTypes
parameters.description: Exact badgeType strings to include.

parameters.name: sortDirection
parameters.description: Selects ascending or descending order by createdAt, then AT-URI.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of definitions to return in the page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page, bound to sortDirection. Keep other query parameters unchanged between pages.

x-lexicon-errors.name: InvalidRequest
x-lexicon-errors.description: A filter, query parameter, page bound, or cursor is invalid.

get.description: Lists raw public badge responses with optional award filtering and pagination without authentication.

parameters.name: badgeAward

parameters.name: sortDirection
parameters.description: Sort direction for (createdAt, uri).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum responses returned.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page.

x-lexicon-errors.name: InvalidRequest
x-lexicon-errors.description: A filter or page parameter is invalid.

x-lexicon-errors.name: BadgeResponseQueryFailed
x-lexicon-errors.description: The indexed badge responses could not be queried.

get.description: Searches badge definitions by title or description without authentication.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Text matched against definition titles and descriptions.

parameters.name: authors
parameters.description: DIDs of repositories that published the definitions.

parameters.name: badgeTypes
parameters.description: Exact badgeType values.

parameters.name: sortDirection

parameters.name: limit

parameters.name: cursor

x-lexicon-errors.name: BadgeDefinitionQueryFailed
x-lexicon-errors.description: The indexed badge definitions could not be queried.

get.description: Returns the representative entity-follow record for an actor and entity AT-URI, or null if none is indexed. No authentication is required; lookup failures return errors rather than null.

parameters.name: actor
parameters.description: DID that published the entity-follow record.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: Full AT-URI of the followed record using a DID authority; any target collection is accepted, and matching is by URI, not CID.

x-lexicon-errors.name: InvalidRequest
x-lexicon-errors.description: The actor DID, entity AT-URI, or another query parameter is invalid.

get.description: Returns the representative follow record for an actor-to-actor relationship, or null if none is indexed. No authentication is required.

parameters.name: actor
parameters.description: DID of the actor who published the follow record.

parameters.name: subject
parameters.description: DID named as the follow record's subject.

x-lexicon-errors.name: InvalidRequest
x-lexicon-errors.description: A DID or query parameter is invalid.

get.description: Lists actors whose follow records name the requested DID as subject. No authentication is required; duplicate relationships are collapsed before pagination, and only the returned actors are hydrated.

parameters.name: actor
parameters.description: DID whose incoming follows are listed.

parameters.name: sortDirection
parameters.description: Sorts by representative follow createdAt and URI; defaults to desc.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum relationships per page; defaults to 25.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque next-page cursor bound to sortDirection; keep the other query parameters unchanged between pages.

x-lexicon-errors.name: InvalidRequest
x-lexicon-errors.description: A DID or query parameter is invalid.

get.description: Lists actors named as subjects by the requested DID's follow records. No authentication is required; duplicate relationships are collapsed before pagination, and only the returned actors are hydrated.

parameters.name: actor
parameters.description: DID whose outgoing follows are listed.

parameters.name: sortDirection
parameters.description: Sorts by representative follow createdAt and URI; defaults to desc.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum relationships per page; defaults to 25.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque next-page cursor bound to sortDirection; keep the other query parameters unchanged between pages.

x-lexicon-errors.name: InvalidRequest
x-lexicon-errors.description: A DID or query parameter is invalid.

get.description: Lists actors following an entity AT-URI. No authentication is required; duplicate actor–entity relationships use the earliest createdAt, with URI ascending on ties. Only the returned page is hydrated: missing profile and organization sidecars are null, while lookup failures return errors rather than partial pages.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: Full AT-URI of the followed record using a DID authority; any target collection is accepted, and matching is by URI, not CID.

parameters.name: sortDirection
parameters.description: Sorts by representative follow createdAt and URI; defaults to desc.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum relationships per page; defaults to 25.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque next-page cursor bound to sortDirection; keep the other query parameters unchanged between pages.

x-lexicon-errors.name: InvalidRequest
x-lexicon-errors.description: The entity AT-URI or another query parameter is invalid.

get.description: Lists entities followed by an actor DID. No authentication is required; duplicate actor–entity relationships use the earliest createdAt, with URI ascending on ties. Only returned-page targets are hydrated and resolved to the latest indexed record by URI; missing or unsupported targets retain their URI and follow with entity null, while lookup failures return errors rather than partial pages.

parameters.name: actor
parameters.description: DID whose outgoing entity follows are listed.

parameters.name: sortDirection
parameters.description: Sorts by representative follow createdAt and URI; defaults to desc.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum relationships per page; defaults to 25.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque next-page cursor bound to sortDirection; keep the other query parameters unchanged between pages.

x-lexicon-errors.name: InvalidRequest
x-lexicon-errors.description: The actor DID or another query parameter is invalid.

get.description: Beta query for raw account- and entity-follow records from any publisher. No authentication is required; duplicates are preserved, and before is an exclusive bound on publisher-declared createdAt. Pages are not a snapshot, so late indexing or concurrent changes may cause records to be missed.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Exclusive upper bound on publisher-declared createdAt, not indexedAt; omit to start with the newest records.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum records per page; defaults to 25.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque next-page cursor; keep before unchanged between pages.

x-lexicon-errors.name: InvalidRequest
x-lexicon-errors.description: A datetime, limit, cursor, or query parameter is invalid.

get.description: Looks up an indexed EVM-link record by exact AT-URI and hydrates its actor. Authentication is not required.

parameters.name: uri
parameters.description: Full AT-URI of an app.certified.link.evm record with a DID authority.

x-lexicon-errors.name: InvalidRequest
x-lexicon-errors.description: The URI is invalid or is not an app.certified.link.evm record AT-URI.

x-lexicon-errors.name: RecordNotFound
x-lexicon-errors.description: No indexed EVM-link record exists at this AT-URI.

get.description: Lists indexed EVM-link records, optionally filtered by actor DID and wallet address. Authentication is not required.

parameters.name: actors
parameters.description: Actor DIDs that own matching records; values within this filter use OR.

parameters.name: addresses
parameters.description: EVM wallet addresses matched case-insensitively; values within this filter use OR.

parameters.name: sortDirection
parameters.description: Order by the record's createdAt timestamp and then AT-URI.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of links to return.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page, bound to sortDirection.

x-lexicon-errors.name: InvalidRequest
x-lexicon-errors.description: An actor DID, EVM address, page bound, cursor, repeated scalar, or query parameter is invalid.

get.description: Returns one indexed location by AT-URI; authentication is not required.

parameters.name: uri
parameters.description: Full location AT-URI with a DID authority; lookup matches the URI, not a CID.

x-lexicon-errors.name: RecordNotFound
x-lexicon-errors.description: No indexed location exists at this AT-URI.

get.description: Lists indexed location records; authentication is not required. Array filters use repeated unbracketed query keys; filters combine with AND, values within each array with OR, and omitted filters are unrestricted.

parameters.name: authors
parameters.description: Filter by author DID.

parameters.name: uris
parameters.description: Filter by full location AT-URI with a DID authority; matching uses the URI, not a CID.

parameters.name: locationTypes
parameters.description: Match exact strings against locationType; empty strings are matched literally.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size; defaults to 25.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque keyset cursor; keep all other parameters unchanged between pages. The cursor is bound to sortDirection, and pagination is not snapshot-isolated.

parameters.name: sortDirection
parameters.description: Sort by a valid zoned createdAt; otherwise indexedAt or stored row creation time, then URI, all in this direction. Defaults to desc.

x-lexicon-errors.name: InvalidRequest
x-lexicon-errors.description: A query parameter is invalid, unknown, or repeated where only one value is allowed.

get.description: Looks up one indexed activity by full AT-URI. Authentication is not required.

parameters.name: uri
parameters.description: Full AT-URI of the activity, using a DID authority.

x-lexicon-errors.name: InvalidRequest
x-lexicon-errors.description: The URI is invalid or the request includes an unsupported parameter.

x-lexicon-errors.name: RecordNotFound
x-lexicon-errors.description: No indexed activity exists at the requested URI.

x-lexicon-errors.name: ActivityQueryFailed
x-lexicon-errors.description: The activity lookup or required hydration failed.

get.description: Looks up one contribution record by exact AT-URI; authentication is not required.

parameters.name: uri
parameters.description: Full AT-URI of the contribution record, using a DID authority.

x-lexicon-errors.name: InvalidRequest

x-lexicon-errors.name: RecordNotFound
x-lexicon-errors.description: No indexed contribution record exists at this AT-URI.

x-lexicon-errors.name: ContributionQueryFailed

get.description: Publicly looks up one indexed contributor-information record by exact AT-URI and includes its publisher.

parameters.name: uri
parameters.description: Full contributor-information record AT-URI with a DID authority.

x-lexicon-errors.name: InvalidRequest
x-lexicon-errors.description: The URI is invalid or is not a contributor-information record AT-URI.

x-lexicon-errors.name: RecordNotFound

get.description: Looks up one indexed rights record by exact DID-authority AT-URI. Authentication is not required.

parameters.name: uri
parameters.description: Full AT-URI of a rights record, using a DID authority.

x-lexicon-errors.name: InvalidRequest
x-lexicon-errors.description: The URI is invalid or does not identify a rights record.

x-lexicon-errors.name: RecordNotFound
x-lexicon-errors.description: No indexed rights record exists at this AT-URI.

get.description: Lists indexed activities. Filters combine with AND; values within each array filter combine with OR, and duplicate values are ignored. Authentication is not required.

parameters.name: authors
parameters.description: Filter by activity repository-owner DID.

parameters.name: hasOrganizationRecord
parameters.description: Filter by whether the activity author has an app.certified.actor.organization/self record, regardless of profile presence.

parameters.name: contributors
parameters.description: Filter by contributor DID, including inline identities and the exact referenced contributor-information version.

parameters.name: involvedActors
parameters.description: Filter by activity repository-owner or contributor DID.

parameters.name: uris
parameters.description: Filter by exact activity AT-URI; results follow the selected sort order, not input order.

parameters.name: sortDirection
parameters.description: Sort by activity createdAt, then URI; defaults to desc.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum activities per page; defaults to 25.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, bound to sortDirection. Keep all other query parameters unchanged between pages.

x-lexicon-errors.name: InvalidRequest
x-lexicon-errors.description: A filter, sort direction, page limit, cursor, or query parameter is invalid.

x-lexicon-errors.name: ActivityQueryFailed
x-lexicon-errors.description: The activity query or required hydration failed.

get.description: Lists contribution records by publisher DID, sorted by createdAt and URI; authentication is not required.

parameters.name: limit

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor bound to sortDirection; keep filters unchanged between pages.

x-lexicon-errors.name: InvalidRequest
x-lexicon-errors.description: An author DID, sort direction, page bound, or cursor is invalid.

x-lexicon-errors.name: ContributionQueryFailed
x-lexicon-errors.description: The contribution records or publishers could not be read from PostgreSQL.

parameters.name: sortDirection

parameters.name: limit

parameters.name: cursor

x-lexicon-errors.name: ContributorInformationQueryFailed

parameters.name: search

parameters.name: authors
parameters.description: Filter by activity repository-owner DID.

parameters.name: hasOrganizationRecord
parameters.description: Filter by whether the activity author has an app.certified.actor.organization/self record, regardless of profile presence.

parameters.name: contributors
parameters.description: Filter by contributor DID, including inline identities and the exact referenced contributor-information version.

parameters.name: involvedActors
parameters.description: Filter by activity repository-owner or contributor DID.

parameters.name: uris
parameters.description: Filter by exact activity AT-URI; results follow the selected sort order, not input order.

parameters.name: sortDirection
parameters.description: Sort by activity createdAt, then URI; defaults to desc.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum activities per page; defaults to 25.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, bound to sortDirection. Keep all other query parameters unchanged between pages.

x-lexicon-errors.name: InvalidRequest
x-lexicon-errors.description: A filter, sort direction, page limit, cursor, or query parameter is invalid.

x-lexicon-errors.name: ActivityQueryFailed
x-lexicon-errors.description: The activity query or required hydration failed.

get.description: Looks up one indexed collection by exact AT-URI. Hydrates its author and exact-version location and tag sibling projections; the original collection record remains unchanged. Missing related target versions are null without hiding the collection. Authentication is not required.

parameters.name: uri
parameters.description: Full collection record AT-URI using a DID authority.

x-lexicon-errors.name: InvalidRequest
x-lexicon-errors.description: The URI is invalid or is not a collection record AT-URI.

x-lexicon-errors.name: RecordNotFound
x-lexicon-errors.description: No indexed collection exists at this AT-URI.

get.description: Resolves one collection's embedded items in source order, one level only. Each target must match the item's exact strong-reference URI+CID; nested collections are summaries, and unavailable versions or unsupported kinds return record null. Pagination follows the latest indexed collection at the same URI across pages, even after collection changes; no version-change error or restart is required. Item additions, removals, or reordering may cause skipped or repeated results. There is no sortDirection parameter. Authentication is not required.

parameters.name: collection
parameters.description: Full collection record AT-URI using a DID authority.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum embedded items in the page; default 25.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque item-pagination cursor. Continue with the same collection URI; it is not bound to a collection version.

x-lexicon-errors.name: InvalidRequest
x-lexicon-errors.description: The collection AT-URI, page bound, cursor, or query parameters are invalid.

x-lexicon-errors.name: RecordNotFound
x-lexicon-errors.description: No indexed collection exists at this AT-URI.

get.description: Lists indexed collections. Pass array filters as repeated query parameters; filters combine with AND, while values in each array are ORed except tagUris, which requires every supplied URI. Authentication is not required.

parameters.name: authors
parameters.description: Repository-owner DID to match.

parameters.name: hasOrganizationRecord
parameters.description: Filter by the author's organization/self record; false matches absence regardless of profile presence.

parameters.name: types
parameters.description: Exact collection type to match.

parameters.name: uris
parameters.description: Match by collection record AT-URI; this does not select a CID version.

parameters.name: itemUris
parameters.description: Match when an embedded item's itemIdentifier.uri equals a supplied AT-URI; matching ignores CID.

parameters.name: tagUris
parameters.description: Require every supplied vocabulary-tag AT-URI to occur in record.tags; matching ignores CID and tag records.

parameters.name: sortDirection
parameters.description: Direction for (createdAt, uri) ordering; defaults to desc.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum collections per page; defaults to 25.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response; use the same sortDirection.

x-lexicon-errors.name: InvalidRequest
x-lexicon-errors.description: A query parameter is invalid or unsupported.

get.description: Searches collection title or shortDescription for the complete trimmed text as a case-insensitive literal substring; blank text adds no search restriction. Other filters combine with search using AND, with OR within arrays except tagUris, which requires every supplied URI. Authentication is not required.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive literal substring in title or shortDescription; blank trimmed text adds no search restriction.

parameters.name: authors
parameters.description: Repository-owner DID to match.

parameters.name: hasOrganizationRecord
parameters.description: Filter by the author's organization/self record; false matches absence regardless of profile presence.

parameters.name: types
parameters.description: Exact collection type to match.

parameters.name: uris
parameters.description: Match by collection record AT-URI; this does not select a CID version.

parameters.name: itemUris
parameters.description: Match when an embedded item's itemIdentifier.uri equals a supplied AT-URI; matching ignores CID.

parameters.name: tagUris
parameters.description: Require every supplied vocabulary-tag AT-URI to occur in record.tags; matching ignores CID and tag records.

parameters.name: sortDirection
parameters.description: Direction for (createdAt, uri) ordering; defaults to desc.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum collections per page; defaults to 25.

org.hypercerts.vocab.tag.main.description: A reusable vocabulary term for classifying any Hypercerts record — for example a land-cover class, a zone role, or a methodology. The vocabulary is domain-general; geospatial categories are simply its first entries. The schema carries portable term data; named vocabulary profiles decide which published terms and attachment points they recognize. Recommended record key: the deterministic form <category>.<key> (for example zone-role.site), as defined by the governing vocabulary profile; Lexicon validation cannot bind a record key to body fields, so writers and indexers enforce that agreement. A tag reference pins the specific version (CID) of the term that the referencing record classified against; consumers resolve the term's current status and supersession by its URI.
